remarks: Luxurious and fully renovated, this corner unit is turn-key. Town & Country is the only 24-hour doorman building in Greenwich. Only one block from Greenwich Avenue and a short distance to many restaurants, Whole Foods, shopping and houses of worship, this condo offers the best of downtown Greenwich living. From the beautiful, new wood floors to the 2 marble baths and the state-of-the-art kitchen, there is nothing to do here but bring your toothbrush. Heated Floors in Kitchen and both Bathrooms. Amenities include - 24-hour doorman, in-house super, indoor parking, storage unit and private balcony. Elevators and common areas are being updated and are scheduled to be finished by the end of the year. Don't miss the chance to live in this desirable building and AAA location.
